name: What does the process of repairing a damaged bathroom door frame involve?

mainEntity.name: What does the process of repairing a damaged bathroom door frame involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a bathroom door frame generally involves isolating the issue, cutting away decayed material, reinforcing structural points, and completing finish work. First, the door slab and trim casing are carefully removed to inspect the rough opening studs for hidden water damage. If repairing, the carpenter cuts out rotted jamb sections and splices in matching wood treated to resist moisture. If hinges are sagging, screw holes are bored out and plugged with solid wood dowels or longer framing screws are set into structural studs. Finally, the opening is re-shimmed for plumb, the door rehung, joints caulked, and matching trim and interior paint applied.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes removing trim, inspecting rough framing, cutting out damaged wood, splicing new material, shimming for proper alignment, and reapplying caulk and paint.
